title: Sunset Notice
description: Stops an API shutdown arriving as a surprise outage: it reads the Sunset (RFC 8594) and Deprecation (RFC 9745) headers and their Link relations off a response, lists exactly what stops working, shows when in the reader's own zone (flagging when that falls on a different day than the header's UTC date), counts down while turning amber then red, and lets "Remind me later" snooze only until the next 30/7/1-day mark.
stops: API shutdown arrives as an outage
